comment.body:
Thanks for reporting the Text Extractor crash. The issue still needs two exact pieces of evidence:

1. Please provide short numbered reproduction steps and say whether it crashes when Text Extractor opens, after you draw the capture region, or after the OCR result is about to appear.
2. Please reproduce the crash again and then add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward. If the normal UI cannot open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory and attach the generated ZIP.

That will tell us which stage of the Text Extractor flow is failing.

confidence.rationale: Affected module is known; trigger is not.
